body.prompt: An 8K resolution, photorealistic industrial design rendering of a quadcopter with a wide X-shaped layout, 35cm rotor-to-rotor distance, 1.3:1 arm span ratio, 52° rotor angle, faceted fuselage, 20cm wing curvature radius, 30° fuselage edge angle, foldable arms, exposed carbon fiber frame, carbon fiber propellers, anodized aluminum honeycomb grille, matte black color scheme, orange LED light band, exposed titanium fasteners, reinforced motor covers, modular quick-release connectors, and a GPS antenna mast on the top surface, all highlighted under a 90° overhead view with soft 5500K lighting and high-contrast shadows. Picture 1 is a top-view plan of the airframe skeleton at the same scale and framing as the output image: four arms and four motor mounts. Keep every motor mount and every arm where it is in Picture 1. The fuselage, the propellers and all other parts are not in the plan; design them from the description. Do not keep the flat grey shapes.
